name: auth-system
//engines: Prisma 7 requires Node 20.19+, 22.12+ or 24.0+, and Next 16 requires 20.9+.
Without this, Railway's Nixpacks picked its own default and the build died
on `npm ci` with 'Prisma only supports Node.js versions 20.19+, 22.12+,
24.0+'. The floor is stated here so any host refuses early and clearly
instead of failing halfway through an install.
The exact version a host installs comes from .nvmrc (22) — Nixpacks reads
that first. This range stays open-ended so local development on Node 24
does not warn on every npm command.

scripts.build: node scripts/bundle-portal.mjs && prisma generate && next build
scripts.start: prisma migrate deploy && node scripts/deploy-seed.mjs && tsx server.ts
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && tsx prisma/seed.ts
